text: Hello, I hope I'm doing this rite, I don't text much. I've got my grandaughter Megan staying with me, she is 10. She's had a temprature since yesterday, it was 37.9 last time I took it about half an hour ago. Now she has been quite chirpy really, when the calpol has kicked in she's been playing cards with me and chatting away and she's been drinking her squash. But I've just realised I don't think she has been to the toilet for a wee since this morning, I'd say it's well over 12 hours now, possibly more, I've been keeping an eye and she hasn't gone. Also she feels cold to touch, which seems odd with a temprature, her hands and feet are like ice and she's been shivvering a lot even under the blanket. I'm not sure if that's normal with a fever or not, I don't remember my own children being like that. Her mum is away until Thursday so I thought I'd better ask someone. Thank you.
